user.title: Connect your Aivi account
user.description: Paste the API token from the Settings tab of the Aivi app. Give the account a name if you connect more than one.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Optional. Change the base URL only to connect to an Aivi API other than the default one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Aivi
reauth_confirm.description: Aivi rejected your API token. Paste a new one from the Settings tab of the Aivi app.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Aivi
reconfigure.description: Update the API token. Open Advanced options to change the base URL.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Optional. Change the base URL only to connect to an Aivi API other than the default one.

error.invalid_auth: Aivi rejected that API token. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Aivi. Check your connection and try again.
error.no_subscription: This Aivi account has no active subscription. Subscribe in the Aivi app, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This Aivi account is already connected.

data_description.keep_log: The log of pushes to Aivi and presses from your devices lives in memory and starts over when Home Assistant restarts. Turned on, it is also written to disk every so often, so it survives a restart. Leave it off on an SD card you want to spare.

auth_rejected.message: Aivi rejected the API token. Reconnect the account to keep your widgets and Live Activities updated.

widget_missing.title: Widget "{name}" isn't in the Aivi app
widget_missing.description: The Aivi app has no widget with the slug "{slug}", so Home Assistant has nothing to feed for "{name}". Create it again in the **Widgets** tab of the Aivi app with exactly that slug, or stop feeding "{name}" in the Aivi panel.

content_rejected.title: Aivi rejected the content for "{name}"
content_rejected.description: Aivi rejected what Home Assistant sent for "{name}" ({slug}) as invalid. Check what feeds it in the Aivi panel. Updates resume once Aivi accepts the content.

content_too_large.title: Content for "{name}" is over the Aivi size limit
content_too_large.description: What Home Assistant would send for "{name}" ({slug}) is over the 4 KiB Aivi accepts, so it is not sent and your devices keep showing the last update. In the Aivi panel, shorten picture URLs or second lines, or remove tiles. Updates resume once it fits.

unsupported_template.title: "{name}" uses a template this version can't feed
unsupported_template.description: "{name}" uses the "{template}" template, which this version of the Aivi integration doesn't support. Update the integration to feed it, or stop feeding "{name}" in the Aivi panel.

activity_missing.title: Live Activity "{name}" isn't in the Aivi app
activity_missing.description: The Aivi app has no Live Activity with the slug "{slug}", so Home Assistant has nothing to feed for "{name}". Create it again in the **Activities** tab of the Aivi app with exactly that slug, or stop feeding "{name}" in the Aivi panel.

template_mismatch.title: "{name}" has a different template in the Aivi app
template_mismatch.description: Aivi refused the content for "{name}" ({slug}) because the widget or Live Activity with that slug has a different template in the Aivi app than "{template}". Stop feeding it and set it up again in the Aivi panel. Updates resume once the templates match.

activity_quota.title: Too many ongoing Live Activities for "{name}"
activity_quota.description: Aivi didn't start the Live Activity "{name}" ({slug}) because the account already has as many ongoing Live Activities as it allows. End another one; the next update tries again.

confirm.title: Check the Aivi subscription
confirm.description:
The Aivi account "{account}" has no active subscription, so its widgets and Live Activities are paused.

Everything you set up in the Aivi panel is kept. Renew in the Aivi app and updates resume within the hour. Renewed already? Select **Check now**.

still_inactive.title: Not renewed yet
still_inactive.description: Aivi still reports no active subscription for "{account}". Renew it in the Aivi app, then select **Check again**. It is also checked every hour.

cannot_connect.title: Couldn't reach Aivi
cannot_connect.description: Check your connection, then select **Try again**.

abort.auth_failed: Aivi rejected the API token. Reconnect the account first.
abort.not_loaded: The Aivi account isn't running. Reload it under **Settings → Devices & services**, then try again.

confirm.title: Check the Aivi subscription
confirm.description:
The Aivi subscription for "{account}" ended on {expired}, so its widgets and Live Activities are paused.

Everything you set up in the Aivi panel is kept. Renew in the Aivi app and updates resume within the hour. Renewed already? Select **Check now**.

still_inactive.title: Not renewed yet
still_inactive.description: Aivi still reports no active subscription for "{account}". Renew it in the Aivi app, then select **Check again**. It is also checked every hour.

cannot_connect.title: Couldn't reach Aivi
cannot_connect.description: Check your connection, then select **Try again**.

abort.auth_failed: Aivi rejected the API token. Reconnect the account first.
abort.not_loaded: The Aivi account isn't running. Reload it under **Settings → Devices & services**, then try again.

automation_conflict.title: "{name}" is also fed by an automation

confirm.title: Turn off the automation feeding "{name}"
confirm.description:
"{name}" ({slug}) is fed from the Aivi panel and also by: {automations}. The two overwrite each other, so your devices flip between them.

Turning the automation off doesn't delete it. You can turn it back on under **Settings → Automations & scenes**.

automation_conflict_manual.title: "{name}" is also fed by an automation
automation_conflict_manual.description: "{name}" ({slug}) is fed from the Aivi panel and also by: {automations}. The two overwrite each other, so your devices flip between them. This automation feeds other widgets too, or turns itself back on when Home Assistant starts, so the Aivi integration doesn't turn it off for you. Change it under **Settings → Automations & scenes**, or stop feeding "{name}" in the Aivi panel.

route.widget-missing: That widget wasn't found. Showing your widgets instead.
route.activity-missing: That Live Activity wasn't found. Showing your widgets instead.

onboarding.title: Connect your Aivi account
onboarding.body: Widgets are built in the Aivi app; Home Assistant feeds them with live data. Connect your account and every widget on it appears here, ready to set up.
onboarding.token-help: Where do I find my token?
onboarding.first-bind-body: {name} now updates whenever the entities that feed it change. There is nothing to refresh.

hub.empty-title: No widgets or Live Activities yet
hub.empty-body: You create them in the Aivi app. Here you pick what feeds them.
hub.empty-step-create: Create a widget or a Live Activity in the Aivi app on your iPhone or iPad.
hub.empty-step-refresh: Press Refresh here. New ones appear then, not on their own.
hub.empty-step-feed: Press Set up on it and pick the entities that feed it.
hub.empty-widgets-note: No widgets yet. Create one in the Aivi app, then refresh.
hub.empty-activities-note: No Live Activities yet. Create one in the Aivi app, then refresh.
hub.offline: Aivi is unreachable. Showing only the widgets you set up.
hub.subscription-inactive: Your Aivi subscription isn't active. Everything you set up is kept and resumes when you renew.
hub.widget-gone: Not in the Aivi app, so nothing is shown. Stop feeding it, or create it again there with the same slug.
hub.activity-gone: Not in the Aivi app, so nothing is shown. Stop feeding it, or create it again there with the same slug.
hub.search-label: Search widgets and Live Activities by name or template
hub.refresh-same: Up to date: nothing changed in the Aivi app.
hub.subscription-inactive-some-one: The Aivi subscription for {names} isn't active. Its widgets and Live Activities are paused until it is renewed. Everything you set up is kept.
hub.subscription-inactive-some-other: The Aivi subscriptions for {names} aren't active. Their widgets and Live Activities are paused until they are renewed. Everything you set up is kept.

editor.slug-hint: Its slug: the ID the Aivi app, repairs and automations know it by
editor.saved-toast: {name} is now fed by Home Assistant
editor.active-hint: Starts the Live Activity when it turns on; ends it when it turns off
editor.template-error-blocks: Fix the template error in {fields} to save.
editor.fix-fields: Fix the fields marked in red to save.
editor.leave-body: What you changed in {name} will not be saved.

recent.title: Log
recent.hint: What Home Assistant last sent to Aivi for this, what your devices sent back, and what became of each.
recent.empty: Nothing yet. The first push to Aivi shows up here, and so does a press on one of your devices.

pushes.unchanged-why: The same content as the last push, so nothing was sent.
pushes.content-cut: Cut off here: the content is longer than the log keeps.
pushes.content-none: Nothing resolved, so there was nothing to send.
pushes.waiting-any: Nothing sent: none of {fields} has a value.
pushes.held: Held until {time}: this Live Activity updates at most {every}. Change it under “{setting}” in {section}.

bands.now-none: {name} has no reading now, so the fixed color shows
bands.order: Type a number above the limit before it and below the one after it.
bands.lock-hint: Colors don't show on the Lock Screen, on a tinted Home Screen or when the screen dims. Show the reading on the widget too, or change its icon with it.

field.pick-entity-first: Pick an entity first, then its attribute
field.entity-missing: This entity isn't available in Home Assistant right now.
field.no-attributes: This entity has no attributes to pick from.
field.source-unusable: Reads “{value}”, which can't be used here. The fallback below applies.
field.source-unavailable: Nothing to read right now. The fallback below applies.
field.fallback-hint: Used whenever the source above can't be read
field.template-empty: This template currently renders to nothing; the field counts as unset.
field.updates-never: Nothing it reads can change, so it never updates on its own.
field.error-unclosed: Something is not closed. Check that every {output} and {statement} is complete.
field.error-unclosed_block: The {tag} block is never closed. Add {end} where it ends.
field.error-unexpected_end: The template ends before everything it opens is closed.
field.error-stray_end: {tag} closes a block that was never opened.
field.error-unknown_tag: “{tag}” is not a statement templates know. Check the spelling.
field.error-bad_char: The character “{char}” can't be used here.
field.error-incomplete: The expression stops too early: something is missing at its end.
field.error-extra: “{token}” does not belong here. Is an operator or a | missing before it?
field.error-undefined: Nothing named “{name}” exists here. Check the spelling.
field.error-none_attribute: This reads “{name}” from something that does not exist, often an entity id with a typo.
field.error-no_default: {function} got “{value}”, which is not a number, and has no default. Give it one, like {example}.
field.error-type: Text and numbers are mixed here. Turn text into a number first, like {example}.
field.url-invalid: Use a full URL with its scheme, such as https:// for a web page or homeassistant:// for a Home Assistant view.
field.url-long: The URL is longer than 256 characters.
field.points-list-hint: An attribute holding a list of numbers, oldest first
field.points-template-hint: A Home Assistant template rendering a list of numbers, oldest first, for example a forecast mapped to its temperatures
field.points-no-history: Feed {field} from an entity, or pick one here, to chart its history.
field.source-waiting: Reads “{value}” right now, so nothing is sent until it has a value.
field.source-waiting-none: Nothing to read right now, so nothing is sent until there is.
field.source-left-out: Nothing to read right now, so this is left out.
field.source-unusable-left-out: Reads “{value}”, which can't be used here, so this is left out.
field.name: {field}

code.fn-states: The state of an entity, as text
code.fn-is_state: Whether an entity is in a given state
code.fn-is_state_attr: Whether an entity's attribute has a given value
code.fn-has_value: Whether an entity has a state, not unknown or unavailable
code.fn-expand: The member entities of groups and lists
code.fn-area_name: The name of the area an entity is in
code.fn-device_attr: One detail of an entity's device, like its model
code.fn-today_at: Today at a given time, like today_at('18:30')
code.fn-as_timestamp: A date or time as seconds since 1970
code.fn-relative_time: How long ago a time was, like 5 minutes
code.fn-timedelta: A length of time, to add to or take from a time
code.fn-iif: One value if a condition holds, another if not
code.fn-float: A number with decimals, with a fallback for text
code.fn-int: A whole number, with a fallback for text
code.fn-is_number: Whether a value is a number
code.fn-round: Rounds a number to a number of decimals
code.fn-default: A value to use when there is none
code.fn-selectattr: Keeps the items whose attribute passes a test
code.fn-map: Takes one attribute of every item, or applies a filter to each
code.fn-list: Turns the result into a list
code.fn-join: Joins items into text with a separator
code.fn-state_translated: The state of an entity, in your language
code.fn-device_id: The id of an entity's device
code.fn-area_id: The id of an area, by its name or an entity in it
code.fn-integration_entities: Every entity of an integration, like 'hue'
code.fn-utcnow: The current date and time in UTC
code.fn-as_datetime: Text or a timestamp as a date and time
code.fn-as_local: A date and time in your time zone
code.fn-strptime: Reads a date and time from text in a given format
code.fn-time_since: How long ago a time was, in words
code.fn-time_until: How long until a time, in words
code.fn-as_timedelta: Text like '00:10:00' as a length of time
code.fn-timestamp_local: A timestamp as a local date and time
code.fn-timestamp_utc: A timestamp as a date and time in UTC
code.fn-bool: True or false, from text like on, yes or 1
code.fn-median: The middle value of several numbers
code.fn-format: Fills a text pattern, like '%.1f' | format(x)
code.fn-slugify: Turns text into a lowercase id with underscores
code.fn-regex_replace: Replaces what a regular expression matches
code.fn-regex_match: Whether text starts with a match of a regular expression
code.fn-regex_search: Whether text holds a match of a regular expression
code.fn-rejectattr: Leaves out the items whose attribute passes a test
code.fn-select: Keeps the items that pass a test
code.fn-reject: Leaves out the items that pass a test
code.fn-length: How many items or characters there are
code.fn-contains: Whether a list or text holds a value
code.fn-range: The numbers from 0 up to a count
code.fn-namespace: Holds values a loop can change
code.test-number: Whether a value is a number
code.test-in: Whether a value is in a list or text
code.test-match: Whether text starts with a match of a regular expression
code.test-search: Whether text holds a match of a regular expression
code.test-contains: Whether a list or text holds a value

sheet.recipe-pick: Pick the entity it is for
sheet.recipe-without: Without an entity, to fill in
sheet.recipe-words: Words for on and off, like Open and Closed
sheet.recipe-rounded-unit: A state rounded, with its unit
sheet.recipe-translated: Its state as Home Assistant shows it
sheet.recipe-fallback: Words for when it is unavailable
sheet.recipe-rounded: A state as a number, rounded
sheet.recipe-share: A percentage as a share from 0 to 1
sheet.recipe-color-by-state: A color for on and off
sheet.recipe-icon-on-off: An icon for on and off
sheet.recipe-above: Whether it is above a limit

workspace.list-keys: ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to insert, → for more
workspace.tab-hint: Tab indents, {keys} lets it move the focus
workspace.step-keys: ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to insert, ← to go back
workspace.hint-limit: Aivi takes {limit} characters here; the rest is cut off.
workspace.hint-clipped: The {size} widget cuts it off at this length.
workspace.hint-kind-number: This field takes a number, and “{value}” is not one, so its fallback shows.
workspace.hint-kind-bool: This field takes true or false, and “{value}” is neither, so its fallback shows.
workspace.hint-kind-color: “{value}” is not a color this field takes, so its fallback shows.
workspace.hint-kind-time: This field takes a date and time, and “{value}” is not one, so its fallback shows.
workspace.hint-kind-other: This field can't use “{value}”, so its fallback shows.
workspace.hint-unavailable: {name} is {state} right now, so the widget shows “{state}”.
workspace.hint-none: It shows “None”: what it reads has no value right now, often an attribute the entity lacks.
workspace.hint-symbol: “{value}” is not in Apple's symbol list, so the device may show no icon.

combobox.more: Showing {shown} of {total}. Type to narrow the list.

checklist.full: That's all {max}. Remove one to add another.
checklist.over: Only the first {max} are sent. Remove the rest.
checklist.none-left: Nothing left to add: every entity that fits is in use.
checklist.reorder-hint: Drag to reorder; Alt+Arrow moves the focused row
checklist.budget-invalid: Use an amount above 0, like 250 or 99.50.
checklist.charging-hint: A binary sensor, or a sensor that reads “charging”. Left empty, the device's own charging sensor is filled in when you save.
checklist.charging-unavailable: Can't read this sensor right now, so no charging bolt is shown.
checklist.today-hint: An energy meter: today's figure is counted from midnight.
checklist.max-hint: Fills a gauge up to this where the reading stands alone, on the Lock Screen.
checklist.max-words: Reads {value} now, which is not a number, so it shows as text with no gauge.

bar.mode-caption-solid: One fill color across the whole bar
bar.mode-caption-segmented: Each phase is its own capsule, filled in order as the value rises
bar.mode-caption-layered: One continuous bar, the Live Activity look

segments.track-label: Color of the part not reached yet
segments.track-style-label: Pattern of the part not reached yet
segments.sourced-hint: Live from {source}; the fallback applies when it can't resolve
segments.fallback-in-use: The fallback size ({pct}%) is in use.
segments.template-empty: This template currently renders to nothing; the fallback size ({pct}%) is in use.
segments.source-fallback: This source doesn't resolve to a usable size right now; the fallback size ({pct}%) is in use.
segments.boundary-locked: This boundary follows a live source; edit that phase's source or fallback instead.

suggest.title: Suggest a setup
suggest.intro: Say what it should show, in your own words, and the form fills in. Or start here:
suggest.footer: Nothing is saved until you press Save.
suggest.model-hint: Each model's settings (its reasoning effort, for one) live with it in Home Assistant.
suggest.enter-hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
suggest.no-mapping: The model returned nothing it could use here. Try naming the entity or being more specific.
suggest.undone: Undone: the form is back to how it was.
suggest.undone-kept: Undone. What you changed by hand since was kept.
suggest.stale: The form changed while the answer was on its way, so it wasn't applied.
suggest.off-not-loaded: Needs an AI provider in Home Assistant. None provides AI Task yet.
suggest.off-no-entity: AI Task is set up but no model provides data generation yet.
suggest.off-what: Describe a widget in your own words and this form fills in.
suggest.hint-tile: Give the first tile a label and a color
suggest.hint-rows: Put the most important row first

rejected.not_a_color: {field}: {value} is not one of the colors
rejected.no_value: {field}: it shows nothing yet, so there is nothing to style

preview.title: Live preview
preview.press-hint: Press any part of the preview to jump to its settings.
preview.skeleton-hint: Nothing to show yet. Press a part of it to jump to its settings.
preview.waiting-none: Nothing is sent while {field} has no value.
preview.waiting-any: Nothing is sent until one of {fields} has a value.
preview.waiting-hint: Press the preview to jump to {field}.

ramp.solid-hint: The whole ring is this color.
ramp.fallback-hint: The whole ring is this color while the reading is not a number.
ramp.fallback-empty: While the reading is not a number, the ring keeps its built-in range.
ramp.solid-empty: Until you pick one, the dial keeps its color range.
ramp.one-stop: One color paints the whole ring. Add another to make a range.

status.label: Status
status.hint: A single state at a glance

switchboard.label: Switchboard
switchboard.hint: Buttons and switches to press from the Home Screen

generic.label: Generic
generic.retired: An older template Aivi no longer supports. Switch it to Progress or Monitor in the Aivi app.

budget.label: Budget
budget.hint: Spending against a budget, by category

trend.label: Trend
trend.hint: A reading and its recent history

energy.label: Energy
energy.hint: Solar, grid, battery and home at a glance

showcase.label: Showcase
showcase.hint: A picture of the thing, its state and readings

remote.label: Remote
remote.hint: A picture of the thing, a reading and buttons to press

field-hint.state: The entity whose state the widget shows
field-hint.target: A timestamp to count down to
field-hint.rows: Each selected entity becomes a row
field-hint.devices: Each selected sensor becomes a row
field-hint.actions: Each selected entity becomes a tile: lights and switches toggle, scenes and scripts run when pressed
field-hint.icon: An Apple SF Symbol; start typing to search by name or keyword
field-hint.accent: The widget's highlight color: the icon chip, and text that carries no color of its own
field-hint.tap_url: Where a tap on the widget goes: a dashboard, an app, a web page
field-hint.end_date: Counts down to this time, in place of the state
field-hint.min_value: Bottom of the dial's range (defaults to 0)
field-hint.max_value: Top of the dial's range (defaults to 1)
field-hint.ring: How the dial is colored across its range, from the low end to the high end
field-hint.expired_text: Shown once the target time has passed
field-hint.compact_value: The one value shown next to the icon while the Island is collapsed
field-hint.spent: What has been spent so far
field-hint.budget: The amount to spend: a number, or live from an entity
field-hint.currency: A three-letter code, like USD or EUR
field-hint.categories: Each selected sensor becomes a category; give it a budget in its options
field-hint.display: Remaining counts down from the budget, Spent counts up
field-hint.total_color: The ring around the headline figure
field-hint.points: Drawn from what Home Assistant recorded, so it is there from the first update
field-hint.entries: A price sensor (Nord Pool, ENTSO-e, Octopus Energy, Amber and the like): its timeline is read from its attributes. One update a day keeps the widget current.
field-hint.color: The line and the fill under it
field-hint.header_left: The banner's top line, at the left
field-hint.header_right: The banner's top line, at the right
field-hint.footer_left: The banner's bottom line, at the left
field-hint.footer_right: The banner's bottom line, at the right
field-hint.left_value: The left column's reading, shown large
field-hint.left_header: The small line above the left reading
field-hint.left_footer: The small line under the left reading
field-hint.right_value: The right column's reading, shown large
field-hint.right_header: The small line above the right reading
field-hint.right_footer: The small line under the right reading
field-hint.primary_column: The column the Dynamic Island shows while collapsed
field-hint.image: A public https URL the device downloads itself, like a car on a clear background
field-hint.image_alt: Read out by VoiceOver in place of the picture
field-hint.reported_at: The widget says how long ago this entity last reported

field-hint-template.state: What the widget shows, as the template renders it

switchboard.subtitle: Second line
switchboard.subtitle-aria: What the second line of {name} shows
switchboard.subtitle-hint: The small text under the tile's name.
switchboard.color-hint: Paints the tile while it is on. Default is the widget's accent color.
switchboard.gradient-hint: A gradient paints the tile while it is on, in place of its color.
switchboard.gradient-color: One of the stops is not a color: use a palette name or #RRGGBB.
switchboard.image-alt-hint: Read out by VoiceOver in place of the picture.
switchboard.image-hint: A public https URL the device downloads itself. Keep it small: at most 256 KB, 1024 px on a side and 1 megapixel, as PNG, JPEG, HEIC, WebP or GIF. The device keeps it for a day, so a new URL shows a new picture right away.
switchboard.image-https: The URL must start with https://.
switchboard.image-long: The URL is longer than 2048 characters.
switchboard.image-host: The URL needs a host name after https://.
switchboard.picture-warn: Only if that URL is public and stable: the device fetches it without Home Assistant credentials, and a URL with a rotating token stops working.
switchboard.picture-local: This entity's picture is a Home Assistant address the device can't fetch, so it can't be used.
switchboard.too-big: Too big for Aivi: {bytes} of {limit} bytes. Nothing is sent until it fits: shorten picture URLs or second lines, or remove tiles.
switchboard.fix-options: Fix the options marked in red to save: {rows}.
switchboard.words-hint: What the tile says in each state. Leave a word empty to use the one shown, or hide it. At most 24 characters.

field-hint-budget.subtitle: Shown with the total, like “20 days left”

field-hint-trend.unit: Defaults to the sensor's own unit
field-hint-trend.min_value: A fixed bottom for the chart (otherwise it fits the data)
field-hint-trend.max_value: A fixed top for the chart (otherwise it fits the data)

field-hint-prices.unit: Defaults to the sensor's own unit

delivery.stale-hint: Once the content is this old without an update, the widget dims it and shows when it last updated.
delivery.stale-keep: As set in the Aivi app
delivery.throttle-hint: iOS allows a Live Activity about 240 updates. Changes in between are held back and the latest goes out when the time is up; starting and ending are never delayed.

gradient.auto-hint: Follows the light's own color while it is on.
gradient.none-hint: No gradient: the tile uses its color.

group-hint-gauge.range: The two ends of the dial. Left empty, it runs from 0 to 1.

group-hint-trend.range: A fixed range for the chart. Left empty, it fits the data.

symbols.placeholder: Search symbols, like washer or lightbulb
symbols.failed: The symbol list couldn't be loaded. Any symbol name still works when typed.
symbols.no-matches: No symbol matches. Any name still works when typed.
symbols.unknown: Not a name in Apple's symbol list. It is kept as typed.
symbols.help: The preview shows a similar icon, or ✦ where it has none. Your device draws Apple's own symbol.

field-hint-status.value: A reading shown large; the state then moves to the line under it

field-hint-gauge.value: The reading the dial points at
field-hint-gauge.unit: Shown after the reading, like °C or %
field-hint-gauge.label: The small line above the dial; the widget's name when empty

field-hint-countdown.subtitle: The small line under the countdown

field-hint-energy.sources: Power sensors of what generates: solar, wind, a generator
field-hint-energy.grid_power: Positive while drawing from the grid, negative while exporting
field-hint-energy.grid_today: An energy meter; today's figure counts from midnight
field-hint-energy.battery_power: Positive while charging, negative while discharging
field-hint-energy.home_power: What the home uses right now
field-hint-energy.home_today: An energy meter; today's figure counts from midnight

field-idle.primary_column: Applies once both columns show something: with one column there is nothing to choose.

events.title: Events from your devices
events.paused-why: The Aivi subscription isn't active, so events from your devices do not arrive.
events.idle-why: Nothing set up here takes input, so there is nothing to listen for. That is expected: listening starts by itself once something does, like a Switchboard or a Remote.
events.empty: Nothing yet. Press a tile on one of your devices and it shows up here as it happens.

log.title: Log
log.empty: Nothing yet. Pushes to Aivi and presses from your devices show up here as they happen.
log.footer-memory: Kept in memory: the list starts over when Home Assistant restarts. To keep it, turn on “Keep the log across restarts” in the account’s options.
log.footer-kept: Kept across restarts: this account writes its log to disk.

conflict.also-fed: An automation also feeds this: {names}. The two overwrite each other.
conflict.also-fed-several: Automations also feed this: {names}. They and this panel overwrite each other.
conflict.turned-off: Automation turned off. Only this panel feeds it now.
conflict.keep-shared: {name} feeds other widgets too, so it is not turned off from here.
conflict.keep-initial_state: {name} turns itself back on whenever Home Assistant starts, so turn it off in its own settings.

field-hint-showcase.image_fit: A cut-out stands on the widget; a photo fills its side
field-hint-showcase.state: A word for how it is, like Locked or Charging
field-hint-showcase.state_icon: Shown in front of the state's word
field-hint-showcase.stats: Each selected entity becomes a reading: Small shows the first, Medium three
field-hint-showcase.badge: A small brand mark beside the report time, left off photos
field-hint-showcase.badge_alt: Read out by VoiceOver in place of the badge
field-hint-showcase.icon: Stands in for the picture while there is none

showcase.too-big: Too big for Aivi: {bytes} of {limit} bytes. Nothing is sent until it fits: shorten picture URLs or labels, or remove readings.

field-hint-remote.value: The big reading, like a car's charge; a number keeps its entity's unit
field-hint-remote.actions: Each selected entity becomes a button: Small shows the first two, Medium up to five
field-hint-remote.stats: Up to three readings, shown from the Large size up
field-hint-remote.image_fit: A cut-out stands beside the reading; a photo sits in a rounded frame
field-hint-remote.icon: Stands in for the picture while there is none

remote.too-big: Too big for Aivi: {bytes} of {limit} bytes. Nothing is sent until it fits: shorten picture URLs or second lines, or remove buttons.

field-hint-activity-remote.value: The big reading, like a vacuum's battery; its unit is a field of its own
field-hint-activity-remote.actions: Each selected entity becomes a button: up to three, with their labels while there are two or fewer
field-hint-activity-remote.stats: Up to two readings, on the Lock Screen while there is no bar
field-hint-activity-remote.image: A public https URL; the device shows it once the app has fetched it, and the icon until then
field-hint-activity-remote.state: A word for how it is, like Cleaning or Charging
field-hint-activity-remote.unit: Drawn right after the value, like % or km
field-hint-activity-remote.value_label: A word under the value, like left
field-hint-activity-remote.progress: Draws a bar from a sensor reporting 0–100; the readings make way for it
field-hint-activity-remote.bar_color: The bar's color; the state's color, else the accent, when unset
field-hint-activity-remote.compact_value: Shown next to the icon while the Island is collapsed; the value and its unit when unset
